BiblicalUsage: Kedemah is a son of Ishmael, named among his twelve princes: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. The same list stands in the chronicle of the sons of Ishmael.
TheologicalSignificance: His name on the list is the record of a tribe, and I hold the record as the proof that God counted them.
